applies_why: The judge text decides the Acts 2:30 dispute by setting the defender's chain ([CR2]/[CR3]) against the challenger's chain ([DR3]) and saying neither forces the other, which is the chain-against-chain weighing K-C governs.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires
why: The judge does not decide by whether any single verse states the contrary; it weighs the two chains and finds neither forces the other, so K-C is obeyed.
